items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: I have a record of Oscar Salastain's memorial record. You remember when he went to play for President Eisenhower back in the early 50s, I think it was?

ctx.x: Um, well, uh, I would like to do that, of course, uh, sometime. But so far, I haven't had to do much of that lately. There's only so much time in a week. Yeah. I have been involved in radio and television many, many times. Maybe Joe will give me a nice off-off.
Too bad they don't put, put it out.

with FM and whatever the other is. AM. AM. Right. Well, I have one more question. I have a record of Oscar Salastain's memorial record. You remember when he went to play for President Eisenhower back in the early 50s, I think it was? John Curran was the narrator on it. And at that time, in that record, he explained something about, I think, when the Saints go marching in, where he had first heard it. Yes. And that he had played it.
